question: Town K is to the east of Town L. Town M is to the south of Town K. Town N is to the west of Town M. Town O is to the north of Town N. Town L is to the north-west of Town O. What is the position of Town K with respect to Town O?
solution:
**Given: **Town K is to the east of Town L. Town M is to the south of Town K. Town N is to the west of Town M. Town O is to the north of Town N. Town L is to the north-west of Town O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce24321e888ca5062e81b6e23dfdf75151815b2237d62e520eed8b397bee9dc3.png] 

Thus, Town K is to the North-east of Town O.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
